scope: Eight current Roadmap completion-unproved targets independently reviewed; five bounded direct decisions and three retained-unproved decisions.

methodology.runtime_boundary: Comparator evidence changes benchmark P3 mapping completion_credit only; product, runtime, browser, representative-task, release and overall-audit completion deltas remain zero.
methodology.no_copy_rule: Behavioural evidence only; no source, schema, UI, assets or wording is copied.
methodology.selection_preimage_rule: Packet-order IDs joined by LF with no terminal LF, UTF-8 without BOM.
methodology.evaluation_proof_rule: Packet-order evaluation objects; JSON sorted keys, compact separators; LF joined without terminal LF; UTF-8 without BOM.
methodology.source_registry_rule: The exact verified file objects embedded here, sorted by path; JSON sorted keys, compact separators; LF joined without terminal LF; UTF-8 without BOM.
methodology.origin_source_registry_pin_boundary: Retained as the research-packet identity only; the materialized registry uses the fully declared embedded objects and its freshly computed digest.
methodology.source_path_rule: Source paths sorted lexicographically and joined by LF without terminal LF; UTF-8 without BOM.
methodology.origin_source_path_pin_boundary: Retained as the research-packet identity only; it is not represented as a replay of the declared path-only rule.

PLANE.edition_boundary: Official public community paths only; Plane Cloud, commercial plans, licence-service behavior, enterprise editor paths, proprietary integrations and uncited behavior excluded.

evaluations.requirement: Provide an authorised roadmap overview with bounded work-state counts, distributions and completion charts.
evaluations.behavior: Permission-bound project and cycle analytics return total, backlog, unstarted, started and completed work plus assignee/state/estimate distributions and completion charts.
evaluations.reason: Project/cycle work-item dashboard analogue only; no Oblivion cross-initiative governance, budget, risk, Site, UI or runtime parity.
No decision-request aggregate with requester, authorised resolver, rationale, due date, governed outcome and resolution provenance.

evaluations.requirement: Manage an initiative-like work container with dates, lead, members, lifecycle state and bounded archive behavior.
evaluations.behavior: Modules persist description, dates, lead, members, work and status; authorised endpoints create/update/delete, record activity and archive or restore eligible completed/cancelled modules.
evaluations.reason: Module analogue only; no exact Oblivion initiative transitions, scoring, budget, benefit, risk, assurance, Site or decision parity.
No manager/executive approval, approver/time/separation, publication gate or immutable published plan revision.

evaluations.requirement: Prepare a bounded named, owned and time-boxed planning cycle with linked work and progress distributions.
evaluations.behavior: Cycles persist name, paired dates, owner/version and linked work; authorised endpoints create/update and expose progress, state and estimate analytics with bounded completed/archive mutation behavior.
evaluations.reason: Time-boxed cycle analogue only; not intrinsically quarterly and no submission, approval, publication, budget/risk snapshot or runtime parity.
Generic issue export/history and work analytics do not prove a typed quarterly-plan report snapshot covering initiatives, priority, budget, risk, assurance and decisions.

evaluations.requirement: Ingest a named, priority-validated suggestion into a durable triage state with source and creator evidence.
evaluations.behavior: Authorised intake validates name and priority, creates a triage-state Issue and IntakeIssue, and records source, creator, activity and description-version provenance.
evaluations.reason: Single authorised intake analogue only; no scheduled adapters, stable external idempotency, Oblivion Site or runtime parity.

evaluations.requirement: Filter and govern suggestion transitions through pending, rejected, snoozed, accepted and duplicate outcomes.
evaluations.behavior: Permission-bound intake lists and updates durable triage statuses; acceptance validates prerequisites, moves the underlying issue from triage to the project default state, and records activity.
